text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the 
 testing procedures P1 for L8b distance relay, which must be 
 performed on an annually bases Y1 as indicated in the title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. 
Abdel Raheem Salem Mohamed Ez, 
tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh, revised by 
quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo.,
and approved by eng. Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of 
 Damietta 
Power Station.
Safety Precautions
Line Isolation and work permit required.
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted.
Voltage Supply to the relay may be alive even after the line is isolated.
Isolate DC supply to relay, when 
 doing any adjustments or maintenance on the relay itself
Ensure all CT path elements are secure after any test disturbance.
BBC Relay Test Set Type Siemene,
Ammeter 5 amp, Phase rotation meter,
Small slot screwdriver, Test leads
5 amp. clip-on ammeter (optional)
